description: Runs example messages against an Advanced mode policy and says which would be flagged, with a score and reason for each. Send a draft policy to try changes before saving them; leave it out to test the saved policy. Mark each example with expect "flag" or "pass" and the summary counts how many came back as expected. The project's word rules run first, as they do live. Nothing is stored. No credits are used, except on a free test key from create_test_api_key, where each message checked counts toward its 100 free messages. Up to 50 examples per call.

api_key.description: Paxmod API key for the project.

expect.description: What the policy should do with it.

policy.description: Draft policy in plain English, up to 1,000 characters. Leave out to test the saved policy.

threshold.description: Flag above this score, 0 to 1. Leave out to use the project's setting.

name: test_policy
title: Test a moderation policy
